author: Wenyong Xie, Aviad Katiyi, Alina Karabchevsky, Atefeh Habibpourmoghadam, Antonio Calà Lesina
name: data-for-figures-of-liquid-crystal-tunable-meta-waveguides
notes:
This dataset contains the numerical data used to generate all figures in the manuscript “Multifunctional Tunable On-Chip Meta-Waveguides Enabled via Liquid Crystals”.
All datasets are provided in CSV or txt format with clearly labeled columns (e.g., wavelength, transmission). The data correspond directly to the figures presented in the manuscript and enable full reproduction of the reported results.
